title: Field extensions
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. The *degree* $[K:k]$ is the dimension of $K$ as a $k$-vector space [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], and $[K:k]=\infty$ when $K$ is not finite-dimensional over $k$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace]. The extension is *finite* if $[K:k]<\infty$, and
*algebraic* if every element of $K$ is algebraic over $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-element]. It is *finite separable* if it is finite and every element has a separable
minimal polynomial over $k$, i.e. if it is finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] (every element of a finite extension is integral over $k$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral], hence algebraic, so its minimal polynomial is defined). Let $p\ge0$ be the characteristic of $k$ [def-pc-field-characteristic]. The extension is *purely inseparable* [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension] if either $p>0$ and every
element $\alpha\in K$ satisfies $\alpha^{p^n}\in k$ for some $n\ge0$, or $p=0$ and $K=k$ (the map $k\to K$ is surjective). An *algebraic closure*
$\bar k$ of $k$ is an algebraically closed field extension of $k$ (every nonconstant polynomial in $\bar k[T]$ has a root in $\bar k$) which is
algebraic over $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure].

split_report.summary: Definition split. Checked the statement against the master blueprint node (order 720; slopmaster2 has no copy) and Stacks fields.tex (Tags 09G3 degree/finite, 09GC algebraic, 09H1 separable, 09HE purely inseparable, 09GS algebraic closure, 09GQ algebraically closed, 09FR characteristic). New leaf def-pc-field-characteristic (CharP/ringChar) for the p the statement used without introducing it. The well-definedness of 'separable minimal polynomial' in a finite extension (finite implies algebraic, Stacks 09GG) is taken from the existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral (integral, hence algebraic) and named in the statement. Existence and uniqueness of an algebraic closure (Stacks 09GT, 09GV), presupposed by the citers' notation k-bar, had no statement node (def-weil-algebraic-closure only mentions them inside a definition): new leaf lem-pc-algebraic-closure-exists-unique, flagged unreachable (nothing cites it yet; the item, a definition, does not cite a lemma about its own notion). Statement changes: p was undefined; it is now the characteristic of k, and the parenthesis 'in characteristic 0 this means K=k' is made the characteristic-0 clause of the definition (as in Stacks 09HE and the cited node), since with p = 0 the power condition would be meaningless. Removed def-pc-scheme from stmt_deps: the statement uses no scheme. Whole item: every clause is one Mathlib class (searches recorded); left as split, not mathlib, because it is five definitions, not one declaration.
